composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Create an original adult, around thirty years old, wearing a fully covering cobalt jacket and an oversized eccentric ring-shaped hat. The hat is acid yellow-green and tilts off center, framing the face without hiding either eye. Give the person a broad calm face, short dark hair, and a small amused smile, with no resemblance to a real individual. Use a risograph-inspired treatment in dusty pink, blue, and lime, with controlled grain and slight color overlap. Angle the shoulders in a relaxed lean while keeping the head central. The portrait occupies three quarters of the square, with the entire hat inside the circular crop. No text, logos, jewelry clutter, or borrowed character costume.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
